note: First start under systemd. Acceptance criterion #5: runUnder MUST be "systemd" on the VPS (not "local" or "test").
Emitted by startDaemon() right after loadSystemdCredentials(). credentialsLoaded carries credstore FILE NAMES (e.g. ["iago-telegram-token"]) that wrote to env on this boot — NEVER the values.

Emitted once per boot in the autoStart loop (daemon/main.ts:3402-3442), ONLY for agents with autoStart:true. The cron pre-register path that wires pr-triage calls registerAgent but emits NEITHER agent-registered NOR agent-spawned, so a pr-triage-only Phase 2 capture has ZERO of these UNLESS an autoStart agent (e.g. hello-world) is configured. NOT per-dispatch and NOT a boot guarantee for cron agents. agentId is the canonical id (org optional). expected/floor_applies:false — presence is bonus, never a floor.

pr-triage 14:00 UTC daily cron. Required only on days the iago-os org has >=1 open PR; on a zero-PR day the daemon emits cron-skipped { reason: "no-open-prs" } instead. 05b treats this as expected (not required) for any single 24h window.

Mutually exclusive with cron-fired on a given tick. reason is one of wake-check-failed | wake-check-timeout | no-open-prs | pr-fetch-failed | prepare-skip. exitCode is null when the wake-check was timeout-killed. count_per_24h is 0 or 1 (0 when a real PR triggered cron-fired instead).

Emitted once per boot in the autoStart loop (main.ts:3429), paired with agent-registered, ONLY for autoStart agents — NOT per cron-fired dispatch (the Shape-1 PTY is registered once at startup and stays alive across many dispatches). Absent for the cron pr-triage path. Real extras: handleId + agentId + sessionId + runtimeId + generationToken (the original Plan 05 [agentId, pid] sketch is wrong — no pid field). expected/floor_applies:false.

Emitted by file-bus.claimTask on O_EXCL win. One per cron-fired run that produced a task file. The companion close-out event is task-resolved (extras: [agentId, filename]) when claimTask moves pending -> resolved. 05b accepts EITHER task-claimed OR task-resolved as the per-run claim signal.
Close-out of a claimed task (pending -> resolved). Releases the cron runningCount slot. Pairs with task-claimed above; 05b counts the pair as one logical claim->resolve cycle per cron-fired run.

SYNTHETIC marker — the daemon has NO dedicated positive Telegram-send telemetry kind. A successful pr-triage send is inferred from the resolved envelope (tasks/resolved/pr-triage-send__*.json) plus the ABSENCE of pr-triage-telegram-send-failed for that run. 05b must NOT require a telemetry line of this kind; it verifies the send succeeded via the failure-event absence + resolved envelope.

The Phase 1 heartbeat loop ticks every 60s (1440/day) but does NOT write one telemetry line per tick by design (it would flood the NDJSON). The original Plan 05 sketch named this heartbeat-tick @ 1440 required; the real kind is "heartbeat" it has NO emit() call site in the daemon — the HeartbeatController runs a 60s interval loop but emits no telemetry line of this kind (the kind is reserved in the telemetry.ts type union, exercised only in telemetry.test.ts). expected_count_per_24h is set to 0 with floor_applies:false so a reader using the structured field alone does NOT assert an impossible 1440-line floor — 05b must treat heartbeat as optional and NOT apply a 95%-of-1440 floor against the NDJSON. Daemon liveness over a 24h window is proven by journalctl + pgrep, not by telemetry lines.

Emitted at boot-recovery — reconciling PRIOR-run agents (cleanShutdowns->graceful, crashes->crash; daemon/main.ts:2906-2919) — and on autoStart-agent shutdown (main.ts:3333). NOT per cron-fired completion (the cron pr-triage PTY stays alive across dispatches). reason is graceful | crash | recycle; for a healthy pr-triage run it is "graceful" with exitCode 0. The original Plan 05 sketch listed [agentId, exitCode]; the real emitter keys on handleId (resolve agentId via the matching agent-spawned event).
